notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
Hey guys the holiday season is just around the corner. ːsteamhappyː

To celebrate another christmas a new update will be available next December featuring some new cups.

Do you think that you have the skill to finish it?

There are new traps and shenannigans to go through and some secrets for you to find.

There are also new characters available!
